play.comments: i tried really hard not to alpha-gamer this and she came through with a few perspectives that really helped move us along. final time was about 100min (hard to say since we had a pause to look up the reason why we ran out of symbols at one point (forgot to pick up riddle cards once. whoops!)). 3 hint cards... but i'm only counting 2 because we seriously neither wanted nor needed Clue 1 for that last thing (ugh that triangle!). oy, i wasted so much time on that intro blurb. but anyway, 6 stars out of 10! woo! not sure we'd play this one again, but i can see that she'd probably have a blast playing the spooky Cabin one with her mom.
